title: The Holly House
description:
Our gorgeous East Nashville home was 1st built in 1929. It was completely renovated in 2015 but care was taken to keep the original charm while updating the space. We hope you'll enjoy our front porch sitting area, carrara marble countertops, spacious walk-in showers, claw foot tub & backyard w/ firepit. 
When/IF you want to get out of the house, we are in the heart of East Nash! Walk to all of its great coffee shops, restaurants, bars & stores or take a quick uber ride 2 miles to downtown!!!

The space
Main Level Amenities (1st floor):

LIBRARY/READING ROOM📚
-Comfy seating
-Books
-Sunny room to enjoy a good book or a quiet morning

GUEST ROOM: 🛌
-Queen bed
-Serviced by the full bath off the hallway

FULL BATH 🚽
-Walk-in shower 
-Single vanity

LAUNDRY ROOM 👚👕
-Washer and dryer (with detergent)
-Iron and ironing board
-Tankless water heater for endless hot water

LIVING ROOM 🛋️
-Smart TV
-Large sectional 
-Located just off the kitchen and the backyard for ease of use

KITCHEN🧑‍🍳
Keurig duo (pods and drip) 
-Fridge: Filtered water + ice maker
-Dishwasher
-Microwave
-Pots and pans, baking dishes, containers for leftovers
-Drinking glasses, bowls
-Crockpot, blender, toaster
-Fully equipped

DINING 🍽️
-Table with seating for 6
-4 barstools at the kitchen island
-Outdoor dining table with seating for 6

GUEST ROOM: 🛌
-Queen bed 
-Attached full bath with shower
-Smart TV

BACK PATIO/BACKYARD 🌇
-Seating for lounging
-Firepit
-Fully fenced
-Dining space, both table and bar with barstools

2nd Floor:
PRIMARY SUITE 🛌
-California King size bed 
-Attached full bath with walk-in shower (2 shower heads!) and clawfoot tub (2 vanities)
-Large walk-in closet
-Smart TV

GUEST ROOM 🛌
-2 Queen beds
-Shares bathroom with primary. Not jack and jill. There is a door into the bath from the hallway.
-Smart TV

House Rules
Follow basic tasks before check-out (trash in dumpster, dishwasher on).

Note: The garage off the alley is used for storage by the owners and not available for guest use. The apartment above the garage is rented to a longterm tenant. There are no shared spaces (including the backyard).

Guest access
Easy street parking at the house.
Ubers and lyfts are quick and easy to get downtown.
Walking distance to East Nashville's shops, restaurants, bars & coffee shops!

Other things to note

I am originally from Birmingham, AL. I moved to Nashville for college in 2000 and except for a few years spent overseas, have been here ever since. I love the city and am excited to share it with visitors. I also do a significant amount of traveling myself and try to bring parts of the places I go back with me. It's part of what makes my space unique. I am an Alabama fan, an NPR junkie, and a coffee fanatic.
